Capital City - Canyon Valley

Prestigious, extravagant, exotic, heavily regulated, and expensive shopping, meals, housing, lodging, healing, crafting, transit, and repair services for a dark fantasy steampunk settlement.

Biome identity

cliff roads, rope bridges, switchback caravan yards, river-bottom markets, echo inns, gorge rail trestles, wind shelters, pulley lifts, and canyon rescue posts.

Market structure

grand bazaars, embassy hostels, luxury hotels, master guild courts, royal hospitals, relic vaults, and regulated portal offices. Elite purchases include tiny plated courses, rare materials, signed masterwork goods, and private appointments.

modules.html:
Capital City settlement module · Deep Mountain

Capital City - Deep Mountain

Prestigious, extravagant, exotic, heavily regulated, and expensive shopping, meals, housing, lodging, healing, crafting, transit, and repair services for a dark fantasy steampunk settlement.

Biome identity

underground halls, mine-rail stations, fungal farms, forge markets, crystal elevators, warm vents, cavern hostels, and tunnel stables.

Market structure

grand bazaars, embassy hostels, luxury hotels, master guild courts, royal hospitals, relic vaults, and regulated portal offices. Elite purchases include tiny plated courses, rare materials, signed masterwork goods, and private appointments.

Availability rule

Capitals have the broadest stock, elite appointments, rare goods, and strict records for dangerous goods.

Settlement service anchors
HostelsInnsTavernsRestaurantsHotelsGeneral StoresMarketplacesArmoriesBlacksmithsCraft ShopsStablesHospitalsApothecariesAlchemistsMagic Item ShopsJewelersFurniture HallsTextile and Clothing ShopsPet SellersCourier and Guild OfficesHousing OfficeSkyship StationPortal Network Building
Included shop/service sections

  2. Strict Placement Rules
  3. Meals, Drinks, Tea, Restaurants, Taverns, Inns, Hotels, and Hostels
  4. Lodging, Baths, Laundry, and Guest Services

  8. Hospitals, Clinics, Temple Clinics, Healing Kits, and Medical Services
  9. Apothecary, Herbalist, Alchemist, Elixirs, Potions, Poisons, and Cannabis Remedies
  10. Armories and Blacksmiths: Weapons, Armor, Thundercoil Gear, and Repairs
  11. Craft Shops, Furniture, Decor, Textiles, Clothing, Repairs, and Household Goods
  12. Stables, Mount Sales, Mount Boarding, Wagons, Freight, and Caravan Services
  13. Pets, Kennels, Animal Training, and Familiar Brokers
  14. Magic Item Shops, Relic Brokers, Scribes, Charms, and Arcane Services
  15. Jewelers, Gemcutters, Relic Appraisers, and Luxury Ornament Shops
  16. Everyday Services: Scribes, Couriers, Bathhouses, Guilds, Banks, Guides, and Mercenaries
  17. Deep Mountain Biome-Specific Goods and Services
  18. DM Use Notes

modules.html:
Capital City settlement module · Deep Sea

Capital City - Deep Sea

Prestigious, extravagant, exotic, heavily regulated, and expensive shopping, meals, housing, lodging, healing, crafting, transit, and repair services for a dark fantasy steampunk settlement.

Biome identity

pressure-sealed guest halls, waterlock entries, coral markets, kelp farms, shellcraft stalls, submersible docks, and air-safe rooms for non-gilled guests.

Market structure

grand bazaars, embassy hostels, luxury hotels, master guild courts, royal hospitals, relic vaults, and regulated portal offices. Elite purchases include tiny plated courses, rare materials, signed masterwork goods, and private appointments.

Availability rule

Capitals have the broadest stock, elite appointments, rare goods, and strict records for dangerous goods.

Settlement service anchors
HostelsInnsTavernsRestaurantsHotelsGeneral StoresMarketplacesArmoriesBlacksmithsCraft ShopsStablesHospitalsApothecariesAlchemistsMagic Item ShopsJewelersFurniture HallsTextile and Clothing ShopsPet SellersCourier and Guild OfficesHousing OfficeSkyship StationPortal Network Building

  2. Strict Placement Rules
  3. Meals, Drinks, Tea, Restaurants, Taverns, Inns, Hotels, and Hostels

modules.html:
Capital City settlement module · Desert Badlands

Capital City - Desert Badlands

Prestigious, extravagant, exotic, heavily regulated, and expensive shopping, meals, housing, lodging, healing, crafting, transit, and repair services for a dark fantasy steampunk settlement.

Biome identity

shade courts, cistern markets, caravanserai, sun cloth sellers, glassworkers, spice tents, wind-scoured inns, and guarded wells.

Market structure

grand bazaars, embassy hostels, luxury hotels, master guild courts, royal hospitals, relic vaults, and regulated portal offices. Elite purchases include tiny plated courses, rare materials, signed masterwork goods, and private appointments.

Availability rule

Capitals have the broadest stock, elite appointments, rare goods, and strict records for dangerous goods.

Settlement service anchors
HostelsInnsTavernsRestaurantsHotelsGeneral StoresMarketplacesArmoriesBlacksmithsCraft ShopsStablesHospitalsApothecariesAlchemistsMagic Item ShopsJewelersFurniture HallsTextile and Clothing ShopsPet SellersCourier and Guild OfficesHousing OfficeSkyship StationPortal Network Building
Included shop/service sections

  2. Strict Placement Rules
  3. Meals, Drinks, Tea, Restaurants, Taverns, Inns, Hotels, and Hostels
  4. Lodging, Baths, Laundry, and Guest Services

  8. Hospitals, Clinics, Temple Clinics, Healing Kits, and Medical Services
  9. Apothecary, Herbalist, Alchemist, Elixirs, Potions, Poisons, and Cannabis Remedies
  10. Armories and Blacksmiths: Weapons, Armor, Thundercoil Gear, and Repairs
  11. Craft Shops, Furniture, Decor, Textiles, Clothing, Repairs, and Household Goods
  12. Stables, Mount Sales, Mount Boarding, Wagons, Freight, and Caravan Services
  13. Pets, Kennels, Animal Training, and Familiar Brokers
  14. Magic Item Shops, Relic Brokers, Scribes, Charms, and Arcane Services
  15. Jewelers, Gemcutters, Relic Appraisers, and Luxury Ornament Shops
  16. Everyday Services: Scribes, Couriers, Bathhouses, Guilds, Banks, Guides, and Mercenaries
  17. Desert Badlands Biome-Specific Goods and Services
  18. DM Use Notes

modules.html:
Capital City settlement module · Forest

Capital City - Forest

Prestigious, extravagant, exotic, heavily regulated, and expensive shopping, meals, housing, lodging, healing, crafting, transit, and repair services for a dark fantasy steampunk settlement.

Biome identity

timber halls, herbal markets, bowyers, woodland inns, mushroom cellars, hunting lodges, and canopy ropeways.

Market structure

grand bazaars, embassy hostels, luxury hotels, master guild courts, royal hospitals, relic vaults, and regulated portal offices. Elite purchases include tiny plated courses, rare materials, signed masterwork goods, and private appointments.

Availability rule

Capitals have the broadest stock, elite appointments, rare goods, and strict records for dangerous goods.

Settlement service anchors
HostelsInnsTavernsRestaurantsHotelsGeneral StoresMarketplacesArmoriesBlacksmithsCraft ShopsStablesHospitalsApothecariesAlchemistsMagic Item ShopsJewelersFurniture HallsTextile and Clothing ShopsPet SellersCourier and Guild OfficesHousing OfficeSkyship StationPortal Network Building
Included shop/service sections

  2. Strict Placement Rules

modules.html:
Capital City settlement module · Grassland Plains

Capital City - Grassland Plains

Prestigious, extravagant, exotic, heavily regulated, and expensive shopping, meals, housing, lodging, healing, crafting, transit, and repair services for a dark fantasy steampunk settlement.

Biome identity

open markets, riding yards, caravan circles, ranch stores, grain halls, hunting camps, and wide-road taverns.

Market structure

grand bazaars, embassy hostels, luxury hotels, master guild courts, royal hospitals, relic vaults, and regulated portal offices. Elite purchases include tiny plated courses, rare materials, signed masterwork goods, and private appointments.

Availability rule

Capitals have the broadest stock, elite appointments, rare goods, and strict records for dangerous goods.

Settlement service anchors
HostelsInnsTavernsRestaurantsHotelsGeneral StoresMarketplacesArmoriesBlacksmithsCraft ShopsStablesHospitalsApothecariesAlchemistsMagic Item ShopsJewelersFurniture HallsTextile and Clothing ShopsPet SellersCourier and Guild OfficesHousing OfficeSkyship StationPortal Network Building
Included shop/service sections

  2. Strict Placement Rules
  3. Meals, Drinks, Tea, Restaurants, Taverns, Inns, Hotels, and Hostels
  4. Lodging, Baths, Laundry, and Guest Services
  5. Housing Purchase and Rental Office
  6. Bulk Food, Grocers, Granaries, and Marketplaces
  7. General Store, Travel Gear, Bags, Rope, Kits, and Survival Goods
  8. Hospitals, Clinics, Temple Clinics, Healing Kits, and Medical Services
  9. Apothecary, Herbalist, Alchemist, Elixirs, Potions, Poisons, and Cannabis Remedies
  10. Armories and Blacksmiths: Weapons, Armor, Thundercoil Gear, and Repairs
  11. Craft Shops, Furniture, Decor, Textiles, Clothing, Repairs, and Household Goods
  12. Stables, Mount Sales, Mount Boarding, Wagons, Freight, and Caravan Services
  13. Pets, Kennels, Animal Training, and Familiar Brokers
  14. Magic Item Shops, Relic Brokers, Scribes, Charms, and Arcane Services
  15. Jewelers, Gemcutters, Relic Appraisers, and Luxury Ornament Shops
  16. Everyday Services: Scribes, Couriers, Bathhouses, Guilds, Banks, Guides, and Mercenaries
  17. Grassland Plains Biome-Specific Goods and Services
  18. DM Use Notes

modules.html:
Capital City settlement module · Hill Plateau

Capital City - Hill Plateau

Prestigious, extravagant, exotic, heavily regulated, and expensive shopping, meals, housing, lodging, healing, crafting, transit, and repair services for a dark fantasy steampunk settlement.

Biome identity

terraced markets, goat stables, ridge inns, windmills, stonecutters, slope farms, and hilltop watch posts.

Market structure

grand bazaars, embassy hostels, luxury hotels, master guild courts, royal hospitals, relic vaults, and regulated portal offices. Elite purchases include tiny plated courses, rare materials, signed masterwork goods, and private appointments.

Availability rule

Capitals have the broadest stock, elite appointments, rare goods, and strict records for dangerous goods.

Settlement service anchors

modules.html:
Capital City settlement module · Island

Capital City - Island

Prestigious, extravagant, exotic, heavily regulated, and expensive shopping, meals, housing, lodging, healing, crafting, transit, and repair services for a dark fantasy steampunk settlement.

Biome identity

harbor markets, sail lofts, fish halls, inn piers, brine cellars, reef pilots, and ferry yards.

Market structure

grand bazaars, embassy hostels, luxury hotels, master guild courts, royal hospitals, relic vaults, and regulated portal offices. Elite purchases include tiny plated courses, rare materials, signed masterwork goods, and private appointments.

Availability rule

Capitals have the broadest stock, elite appointments, rare goods, and strict records for dangerous goods.

Settlement service anchors
HostelsInnsTavernsRestaurantsHotelsGeneral StoresMarketplacesArmoriesBlacksmithsCraft ShopsStablesHospitalsApothecariesAlchemistsMagic Item ShopsJewelersFurniture HallsTextile and Clothing ShopsPet SellersCourier and Guild OfficesHousing OfficeSkyship StationPortal Network Building
Included shop/service sections
  1. Location Profile
  2. Strict Placement Rules
  3. Meals, Drinks, Tea, Restaurants, Taverns, Inns, Hotels, and Hostels
  4. Lodging, Baths, Laundry, and Guest Services
  5. Housing Purchase and Rental Office
  6. Bulk Food, Grocers, Granaries, and Marketplaces
  7. General Store, Travel Gear, Bags, Rope, Kits, and Survival Goods
  8. Hospitals, Clinics, Temple Clinics, Healing Kits, and Medical Services
  9. Apothecary, Herbalist, Alchemist, Elixirs, Potions, Poisons, and Cannabis Remedies
  10. Armories and Blacksmiths: Weapons, Armor, Thundercoil Gear, and Repairs
  11. Craft Shops, Furniture, Decor, Textiles, Clothing, Repairs, and Household Goods
  12. Stables, Mount Sales, Mount Boarding, Wagons, Freight, and Caravan Services
  13. Pets, Kennels, Animal Training, and Familiar Brokers
  14. Magic Item Shops, Relic Brokers, Scribes, Charms, and Arcane Services
  15. Jewelers, Gemcutters, Relic Appraisers, and Luxury Ornament Shops
  16. Everyday Services: Scribes, Couriers, Bathhouses, Guilds, Banks, Guides, and Mercenaries
  17. Island Biome-Specific Goods and Services
  18. DM Use Notes

modules.html:
Capital City settlement module · Lake River

Capital City - Lake River

Prestigious, extravagant, exotic, heavily regulated, and expensive shopping, meals, housing, lodging, healing, crafting, transit, and repair services for a dark fantasy steampunk settlement.

Biome identity

river docks, canal markets, reedcraft shops, ferry inns, fish smokehouses, water mills, and boatwright yards.

Market structure

grand bazaars, embassy hostels, luxury hotels, master guild courts, royal hospitals, relic vaults, and regulated portal offices. Elite purchases include tiny plated courses, rare materials, signed masterwork goods, and private appointments.

Availability rule

Capitals have the broadest stock, elite appointments, rare goods, and strict records for dangerous goods.

Settlement service anchors

modules.html:
Capital City settlement module · Mountain

Capital City - Mountain

Prestigious, extravagant, exotic, heavily regulated, and expensive shopping, meals, housing, lodging, healing, crafting, transit, and repair services for a dark fantasy steampunk settlement.

Biome identity

high-pass hostels, goat paths, rope bridges, alpine herb stalls, quarry yards, snow shelters, and switchback roads.

Market structure

grand bazaars, embassy hostels, luxury hotels, master guild courts, royal hospitals, relic vaults, and regulated portal offices. Elite purchases include tiny plated courses, rare materials, signed masterwork goods, and private appointments.

Availability rule

Capitals have the broadest stock, elite appointments, rare goods, and strict records for dangerous goods.

Settlement service anchors
HostelsInnsTavernsRestaurantsHotelsGeneral StoresMarketplacesArmoriesBlacksmithsCraft ShopsStablesHospitalsApothecariesAlchemistsMagic Item ShopsJewelersFurniture HallsTextile and Clothing ShopsPet SellersCourier and Guild OfficesHousing OfficeSkyship StationPortal Network Building

  2. Strict Placement Rules
  3. Meals, Drinks, Tea, Restaurants, Taverns, Inns, Hotels, and Hostels

  8. Hospitals, Clinics, Temple Clinics, Healing Kits, and Medical Services

  10. Armories and Blacksmiths: Weapons, Armor, Thundercoil Gear, and Repairs
  11. Craft Shops, Furniture, Decor, Textiles, Clothing, Repairs, and Household Goods
  12. Stables, Mount Sales, Mount Boarding, Wagons, Freight, and Caravan Services
  13. Pets, Kennels, Animal Training, and Familiar Brokers
  14. Magic Item Shops, Relic Brokers, Scribes, Charms, and Arcane Services
  15. Jewelers, Gemcutters, Relic Appraisers, and Luxury Ornament Shops
  16. Everyday Services: Scribes, Couriers, Bathhouses, Guilds, Banks, Guides, and Mercenaries
  17. Mountain Biome-Specific Goods and Services
  18. DM Use Notes

modules.html:
Capital City settlement module · Rainforest

Capital City - Rainforest

Prestigious, extravagant, exotic, heavily regulated, and expensive shopping, meals, housing, lodging, healing, crafting, transit, and repair services for a dark fantasy steampunk settlement.

Biome identity

canopy markets, covered walkways, medicinal gardens, insect-screen hostels, river skiffs, resin craft shops, and storm shelters.

Market structure

grand bazaars, embassy hostels, luxury hotels, master guild courts, royal hospitals, relic vaults, and regulated portal offices. Elite purchases include tiny plated courses, rare materials, signed masterwork goods, and private appointments.

Availability rule

Capitals have the broadest stock, elite appointments, rare goods, and strict records for dangerous goods.

Settlement service anchors

modules.html:
Capital City settlement module · Surface Docks Coastal

Capital City - Surface Docks Coastal

Prestigious, extravagant, exotic, heavily regulated, and expensive shopping, meals, housing, lodging, healing, crafting, transit, and repair services for a dark fantasy steampunk settlement.

Biome identity

steamship docks, warehouses, seafood markets, ship chandlers, dock taverns, ferry offices, and coastal patrol posts.

Market structure

grand bazaars, embassy hostels, luxury hotels, master guild courts, royal hospitals, relic vaults, and regulated portal offices. Elite purchases include tiny plated courses, rare materials, signed masterwork goods, and private appointments.

Availability rule

Capitals have the broadest stock, elite appointments, rare goods, and strict records for dangerous goods.

Settlement service anchors
HostelsInnsTavernsRestaurantsHotelsGeneral StoresMarketplacesArmoriesBlacksmithsCraft ShopsStablesHospitalsApothecariesAlchemistsMagic Item ShopsJewelersFurniture HallsTextile and Clothing ShopsPet SellersCourier and Guild OfficesHousing OfficeSkyship StationPortal Network Building

  2. Strict Placement Rules
  3. Meals, Drinks, Tea, Restaurants, Taverns, Inns, Hotels, and Hostels

  10. Armories and Blacksmiths: Weapons, Armor, Thundercoil Gear, and Repairs
  11. Craft Shops, Furniture, Decor, Textiles, Clothing, Repairs, and Household Goods
  12. Stables, Mount Sales, Mount Boarding, Wagons, Freight, and Caravan Services
  13. Pets, Kennels, Animal Training, and Familiar Brokers
  14. Magic Item Shops, Relic Brokers, Scribes, Charms, and Arcane Services
  15. Jewelers, Gemcutters, Relic Appraisers, and Luxury Ornament Shops
  16. Everyday Services: Scribes, Couriers, Bathhouses, Guilds, Banks, Guides, and Mercenaries
  17. Surface Docks Coastal Biome-Specific Goods and Services
  18. DM Use Notes

modules.html:
Capital City settlement module · Swamp Marsh

Capital City - Swamp Marsh

Prestigious, extravagant, exotic, heavily regulated, and expensive shopping, meals, housing, lodging, healing, crafting, transit, and repair services for a dark fantasy steampunk settlement.

Biome identity

stilt markets, poleboat rentals, peat fires, reed houses, leech doctors, mosquito-net inns, and marsh guide camps.

Market structure

grand bazaars, embassy hostels, luxury hotels, master guild courts, royal hospitals, relic vaults, and regulated portal offices. Elite purchases include tiny plated courses, rare materials, signed masterwork goods, and private appointments.

Availability rule

Capitals have the broadest stock, elite appointments, rare goods, and strict records for dangerous goods.

Settlement service anchors

modules.html:
City settlement module · Canyon Valley

City - Canyon Valley

Broad, crowded, specialized, fashionable, and more expensive shopping, meals, housing, lodging, healing, crafting, transit, and repair services for a dark fantasy steampunk settlement.

Biome identity

cliff roads, rope bridges, switchback caravan yards, river-bottom markets, echo inns, gorge rail trestles, wind shelters, pulley lifts, and canyon rescue posts.

Market structure

district markets, guild halls, hotels, armory rows, hospitals, restaurants, bazaars, and licensed arcane counters. Fine goods, rare goods, and commissioned masterwork services are common.

Availability rule

Cities have full permanent districts; almost every listed item can be purchased without waiting unless it is restricted.

Settlement service anchors
HostelsInnsTavernsRestaurantsHotelsGeneral StoresMarketplacesArmoriesBlacksmithsCraft ShopsStablesHospitalsApothecariesAlchemistsMagic Item ShopsJewelersFurniture HallsTextile and Clothing ShopsPet SellersCourier and Guild OfficesHousing OfficeSkyship StationPortal Network Building

  2. Strict Placement Rules

  10. Armories and Blacksmiths: Weapons, Armor, Thundercoil Gear, and Repairs
  11. Craft Shops, Furniture, Decor, Textiles, Clothing, Repairs, and Household Goods
  12. Stables, Mount Sales, Mount Boarding, Wagons, Freight, and Caravan Services
  13. Pets, Kennels, Animal Training, and Familiar Brokers
  14. Magic Item Shops, Relic Brokers, Scribes, Charms, and Arcane Services
  15. Jewelers, Gemcutters, Relic Appraisers, and Luxury Ornament Shops
  16. Everyday Services: Scribes, Couriers, Bathhouses, Guilds, Banks, Guides, and Mercenaries
  17. Canyon Valley Biome-Specific Goods and Services
  18. DM Use Notes

modules.html:
City settlement module · Deep Mountain

City - Deep Mountain

Broad, crowded, specialized, fashionable, and more expensive shopping, meals, housing, lodging, healing, crafting, transit, and repair services for a dark fantasy steampunk settlement.

Biome identity

underground halls, mine-rail stations, fungal farms, forge markets, crystal elevators, warm vents, cavern hostels, and tunnel stables.

Market structure

district markets, guild halls, hotels, armory rows, hospitals, restaurants, bazaars, and licensed arcane counters. Fine goods, rare goods, and commissioned masterwork services are common.

Availability rule

Cities have full permanent districts; almost every listed item can be purchased without waiting unless it is restricted.

Settlement service anchors
HostelsInnsTavernsRestaurantsHotelsGeneral StoresMarketplacesArmoriesBlacksmithsCraft ShopsStablesHospitalsApothecariesAlchemistsMagic Item ShopsJewelersFurniture HallsTextile and Clothing ShopsPet SellersCourier and Guild OfficesHousing OfficeSkyship StationPortal Network Building

modules.html:
City settlement module · Deep Sea

City - Deep Sea

Broad, crowded, specialized, fashionable, and more expensive shopping, meals, housing, lodging, healing, crafting, transit, and repair services for a dark fantasy steampunk settlement.

Biome identity

pressure-sealed guest halls, waterlock entries, coral markets, kelp farms, shellcraft stalls, submersible docks, and air-safe rooms for non-gilled guests.

Market structure

district markets, guild halls, hotels, armory rows, hospitals, restaurants, bazaars, and licensed arcane counters. Fine goods, rare goods, and commissioned masterwork services are common.

Availability rule

Cities have full permanent districts; almost every listed item can be purchased without waiting unless it is restricted.

Settlement service anchors
HostelsInnsTavernsRestaurantsHotelsGeneral StoresMarketplacesArmoriesBlacksmithsCraft ShopsStablesHospitalsApothecariesAlchemistsMagic Item ShopsJewelersFurniture HallsTextile and Clothing ShopsPet SellersCourier and Guild OfficesHousing OfficeSkyship StationPortal Network Building
Included shop/service sections
  1. Location Profile
  2. Strict Placement Rules
  3. Meals, Drinks, Tea, Restaurants, Taverns, Inns, Hotels, and Hostels
  4. Lodging, Baths, Laundry, and Guest Services
  5. Housing Purchase and Rental Office
  6. Bulk Food, Grocers, Granaries, and Marketplaces
  7. General Store, Travel Gear, Bags, Rope, Kits, and Survival Goods
  8. Hospitals, Clinics, Temple Clinics, Healing Kits, and Medical Services
  9. Apothecary, Herbalist, Alchemist, Elixirs, Potions, Poisons, and Cannabis Remedies
  10. Armories and Blacksmiths: Weapons, Armor, Thundercoil Gear, and Repairs
  11. Craft Shops, Furniture, Decor, Textiles, Clothing, Repairs, and Household Goods
  12. Stables, Mount Sales, Mount Boarding, Wagons, Freight, and Caravan Services
  13. Pets, Kennels, Animal Training, and Familiar Brokers
  14. Magic Item Shops, Relic Brokers, Scribes, Charms, and Arcane Services
  15. Jewelers, Gemcutters, Relic Appraisers, and Luxury Ornament Shops
  16. Everyday Services: Scribes, Couriers, Bathhouses, Guilds, Banks, Guides, and Mercenaries
  17. Deep Sea Biome-Specific Goods and Services
  18. DM Use Notes

modules.html:
City settlement module · Desert Badlands

City - Desert Badlands

Broad, crowded, specialized, fashionable, and more expensive shopping, meals, housing, lodging, healing, crafting, transit, and repair services for a dark fantasy steampunk settlement.

Biome identity

shade courts, cistern markets, caravanserai, sun cloth sellers, glassworkers, spice tents, wind-scoured inns, and guarded wells.

Market structure

district markets, guild halls, hotels, armory rows, hospitals, restaurants, bazaars, and licensed arcane counters. Fine goods, rare goods, and commissioned masterwork services are common.

Availability rule

Cities have full permanent districts; almost every listed item can be purchased without waiting unless it is restricted.

Settlement service anchors

modules.html:
City settlement module · Forest

City - Forest

Broad, crowded, specialized, fashionable, and more expensive shopping, meals, housing, lodging, healing, crafting, transit, and repair services for a dark fantasy steampunk settlement.

Biome identity

timber halls, herbal markets, bowyers, woodland inns, mushroom cellars, hunting lodges, and canopy ropeways.

Market structure

district markets, guild halls, hotels, armory rows, hospitals, restaurants, bazaars, and licensed arcane counters. Fine goods, rare goods, and commissioned masterwork services are common.

Availability rule

Cities have full permanent districts; almost every listed item can be purchased without waiting unless it is restricted.

Settlement service anchors
HostelsInnsTavernsRestaurantsHotelsGeneral StoresMarketplacesArmoriesBlacksmithsCraft ShopsStablesHospitalsApothecariesAlchemistsMagic Item ShopsJewelersFurniture HallsTextile and Clothing ShopsPet SellersCourier and Guild OfficesHousing OfficeSkyship StationPortal Network Building
Included shop/service sections
  1. Location Profile
  2. Strict Placement Rules
  3. Meals, Drinks, Tea, Restaurants, Taverns, Inns, Hotels, and Hostels
  4. Lodging, Baths, Laundry, and Guest Services
  5. Housing Purchase and Rental Office
  6. Bulk Food, Grocers, Granaries, and Marketplaces
  7. General Store, Travel Gear, Bags, Rope, Kits, and Survival Goods
  8. Hospitals, Clinics, Temple Clinics, Healing Kits, and Medical Services
  9. Apothecary, Herbalist, Alchemist, Elixirs, Potions, Poisons, and Cannabis Remedies
  10. Armories and Blacksmiths: Weapons, Armor, Thundercoil Gear, and Repairs
  11. Craft Shops, Furniture, Decor, Textiles, Clothing, Repairs, and Household Goods
  12. Stables, Mount Sales, Mount Boarding, Wagons, Freight, and Caravan Services
  13. Pets, Kennels, Animal Training, and Familiar Brokers
  14. Magic Item Shops, Relic Brokers, Scribes, Charms, and Arcane Services
  15. Jewelers, Gemcutters, Relic Appraisers, and Luxury Ornament Shops
  16. Everyday Services: Scribes, Couriers, Bathhouses, Guilds, Banks, Guides, and Mercenaries
  17. Forest Biome-Specific Goods and Services
  18. DM Use Notes

modules.html:
City settlement module · Grassland Plains

City - Grassland Plains

Broad, crowded, specialized, fashionable, and more expensive shopping, meals, housing, lodging, healing, crafting, transit, and repair services for a dark fantasy steampunk settlement.

Biome identity

open markets, riding yards, caravan circles, ranch stores, grain halls, hunting camps, and wide-road taverns.

Market structure

district markets, guild halls, hotels, armory rows, hospitals, restaurants, bazaars, and licensed arcane counters. Fine goods, rare goods, and commissioned masterwork services are common.

Availability rule

Cities have full permanent districts; almost every listed item can be purchased without waiting unless it is restricted.

Settlement service anchors

modules.html:
City settlement module · Hill Plateau

City - Hill Plateau

Broad, crowded, specialized, fashionable, and more expensive shopping, meals, housing, lodging, healing, crafting, transit, and repair services for a dark fantasy steampunk settlement.

Biome identity

terraced markets, goat stables, ridge inns, windmills, stonecutters, slope farms, and hilltop watch posts.

Market structure

district markets, guild halls, hotels, armory rows, hospitals, restaurants, bazaars, and licensed arcane counters. Fine goods, rare goods, and commissioned masterwork services are common.

Availability rule

Cities have full permanent districts; almost every listed item can be purchased without waiting unless it is restricted.

Settlement service anchors
HostelsInnsTavernsRestaurantsHotelsGeneral StoresMarketplacesArmoriesBlacksmithsCraft ShopsStablesHospitalsApothecariesAlchemistsMagic Item ShopsJewelersFurniture HallsTextile and Clothing ShopsPet SellersCourier and Guild OfficesHousing OfficeSkyship StationPortal Network Building

  10. Armories and Blacksmiths: Weapons, Armor, Thundercoil Gear, and Repairs
  11. Craft Shops, Furniture, Decor, Textiles, Clothing, Repairs, and Household Goods
  12. Stables, Mount Sales, Mount Boarding, Wagons, Freight, and Caravan Services
  13. Pets, Kennels, Animal Training, and Familiar Brokers
  14. Magic Item Shops, Relic Brokers, Scribes, Charms, and Arcane Services
  15. Jewelers, Gemcutters, Relic Appraisers, and Luxury Ornament Shops
  16. Everyday Services: Scribes, Couriers, Bathhouses, Guilds, Banks, Guides, and Mercenaries
  17. Hill Plateau Biome-Specific Goods and Services
  18. DM Use Notes

modules.html:
City settlement module · Island

City - Island

Broad, crowded, specialized, fashionable, and more expensive shopping, meals, housing, lodging, healing, crafting, transit, and repair services for a dark fantasy steampunk settlement.

Biome identity

harbor markets, sail lofts, fish halls, inn piers, brine cellars, reef pilots, and ferry yards.

Market structure

district markets, guild halls, hotels, armory rows, hospitals, restaurants, bazaars, and licensed arcane counters. Fine goods, rare goods, and commissioned masterwork services are common.

Availability rule

Cities have full permanent districts; almost every listed item can be purchased without waiting unless it is restricted.

Settlement service anchors
HostelsInnsTavernsRestaurantsHotelsGeneral StoresMarketplacesArmoriesBlacksmithsCraft ShopsStablesHospitalsApothecariesAlchemistsMagic Item ShopsJewelersFurniture HallsTextile and Clothing ShopsPet SellersCourier and Guild OfficesHousing OfficeSkyship StationPortal Network Building

  10. Armories and Blacksmiths: Weapons, Armor, Thundercoil Gear, and Repairs
  11. Craft Shops, Furniture, Decor, Textiles, Clothing, Repairs, and Household Goods
  12. Stables, Mount Sales, Mount Boarding, Wagons, Freight, and Caravan Services
  13. Pets, Kennels, Animal Training, and Familiar Brokers
  14. Magic Item Shops, Relic Brokers, Scribes, Charms, and Arcane Services
  15. Jewelers, Gemcutters, Relic Appraisers, and Luxury Ornament Shops
  16. Everyday Services: Scribes, Couriers, Bathhouses, Guilds, Banks, Guides, and Mercenaries
  17. Island Biome-Specific Goods and Services
  18. DM Use Notes

modules.html:
City settlement module · Lake River

City - Lake River

Broad, crowded, specialized, fashionable, and more expensive shopping, meals, housing, lodging, healing, crafting, transit, and repair services for a dark fantasy steampunk settlement.

Biome identity

river docks, canal markets, reedcraft shops, ferry inns, fish smokehouses, water mills, and boatwright yards.

Market structure

district markets, guild halls, hotels, armory rows, hospitals, restaurants, bazaars, and licensed arcane counters. Fine goods, rare goods, and commissioned masterwork services are common.

Availability rule

Cities have full permanent districts; almost every listed item can be purchased without waiting unless it is restricted.

Settlement service anchors
HostelsInnsTavernsRestaurantsHotelsGeneral StoresMarketplacesArmoriesBlacksmithsCraft ShopsStablesHospitalsApothecariesAlchemistsMagic Item ShopsJewelersFurniture HallsTextile and Clothing ShopsPet SellersCourier and Guild OfficesHousing OfficeSkyship StationPortal Network Building

  10. Armories and Blacksmiths: Weapons, Armor, Thundercoil Gear, and Repairs
  11. Craft Shops, Furniture, Decor, Textiles, Clothing, Repairs, and Household Goods
  12. Stables, Mount Sales, Mount Boarding, Wagons, Freight, and Caravan Services
  13. Pets, Kennels, Animal Training, and Familiar Brokers
  14. Magic Item Shops, Relic Brokers, Scribes, Charms, and Arcane Services
  15. Jewelers, Gemcutters, Relic Appraisers, and Luxury Ornament Shops
  16. Everyday Services: Scribes, Couriers, Bathhouses, Guilds, Banks, Guides, and Mercenaries
  17. Lake River Biome-Specific Goods and Services
  18. DM Use Notes

modules.html:
City settlement module · Mountain

City - Mountain

Broad, crowded, specialized, fashionable, and more expensive shopping, meals, housing, lodging, healing, crafting, transit, and repair services for a dark fantasy steampunk settlement.

Biome identity

high-pass hostels, goat paths, rope bridges, alpine herb stalls, quarry yards, snow shelters, and switchback roads.

Market structure

district markets, guild halls, hotels, armory rows, hospitals, restaurants, bazaars, and licensed arcane counters. Fine goods, rare goods, and commissioned masterwork services are common.

Availability rule

Cities have full permanent districts; almost every listed item can be purchased without waiting unless it is restricted.

Settlement service anchors
HostelsInnsTavernsRestaurantsHotelsGeneral StoresMarketplacesArmoriesBlacksmithsCraft ShopsStablesHospitalsApothecariesAlchemistsMagic Item ShopsJewelersFurniture HallsTextile and Clothing ShopsPet SellersCourier and Guild OfficesHousing OfficeSkyship StationPortal Network Building

  2. Strict Placement Rules

  8. Hospitals, Clinics, Temple Clinics, Healing Kits, and Medical Services

  10. Armories and Blacksmiths: Weapons, Armor, Thundercoil Gear, and Repairs
  11. Craft Shops, Furniture, Decor, Textiles, Clothing, Repairs, and Household Goods
  12. Stables, Mount Sales, Mount Boarding, Wagons, Freight, and Caravan Services
  13. Pets, Kennels, Animal Training, and Familiar Brokers
  14. Magic Item Shops, Relic Brokers, Scribes, Charms, and Arcane Services
  15. Jewelers, Gemcutters, Relic Appraisers, and Luxury Ornament Shops
  16. Everyday Services: Scribes, Couriers, Bathhouses, Guilds, Banks, Guides, and Mercenaries
  17. Mountain Biome-Specific Goods and Services
  18. DM Use Notes

modules.html:
City settlement module · Rainforest

City - Rainforest

Broad, crowded, specialized, fashionable, and more expensive shopping, meals, housing, lodging, healing, crafting, transit, and repair services for a dark fantasy steampunk settlement.

Biome identity

canopy markets, covered walkways, medicinal gardens, insect-screen hostels, river skiffs, resin craft shops, and storm shelters.

Market structure

district markets, guild halls, hotels, armory rows, hospitals, restaurants, bazaars, and licensed arcane counters. Fine goods, rare goods, and commissioned masterwork services are common.

Availability rule

Cities have full permanent districts; almost every listed item can be purchased without waiting unless it is restricted.

Settlement service anchors
HostelsInnsTavernsRestaurantsHotelsGeneral StoresMarketplacesArmoriesBlacksmithsCraft ShopsStablesHospitalsApothecariesAlchemistsMagic Item ShopsJewelersFurniture HallsTextile and Clothing ShopsPet SellersCourier and Guild OfficesHousing OfficeSkyship StationPortal Network Building
Included shop/service sections
  1. Location Profile
  2. Strict Placement Rules
  3. Meals, Drinks, Tea, Restaurants, Taverns, Inns, Hotels, and Hostels
  4. Lodging, Baths, Laundry, and Guest Services
  5. Housing Purchase and Rental Office
  6. Bulk Food, Grocers, Granaries, and Marketplaces
  7. General Store, Travel Gear, Bags, Rope, Kits, and Survival Goods
  8. Hospitals, Clinics, Temple Clinics, Healing Kits, and Medical Services
  9. Apothecary, Herbalist, Alchemist, Elixirs, Potions, Poisons, and Cannabis Remedies
  10. Armories and Blacksmiths: Weapons, Armor, Thundercoil Gear, and Repairs
  11. Craft Shops, Furniture, Decor, Textiles, Clothing, Repairs, and Household Goods
  12. Stables, Mount Sales, Mount Boarding, Wagons, Freight, and Caravan Services
  13. Pets, Kennels, Animal Training, and Familiar Brokers
  14. Magic Item Shops, Relic Brokers, Scribes, Charms, and Arcane Services
  15. Jewelers, Gemcutters, Relic Appraisers, and Luxury Ornament Shops
  16. Everyday Services: Scribes, Couriers, Bathhouses, Guilds, Banks, Guides, and Mercenaries
  17. Rainforest Biome-Specific Goods and Services
  18. DM Use Notes

modules.html:
City settlement module · Surface Docks Coastal

City - Surface Docks Coastal

Broad, crowded, specialized, fashionable, and more expensive shopping, meals, housing, lodging, healing, crafting, transit, and repair services for a dark fantasy steampunk settlement.

Biome identity

steamship docks, warehouses, seafood markets, ship chandlers, dock taverns, ferry offices, and coastal patrol posts.

Market structure

district markets, guild halls, hotels, armory rows, hospitals, restaurants, bazaars, and licensed arcane counters. Fine goods, rare goods, and commissioned masterwork services are common.

Availability rule

Cities have full permanent districts; almost every listed item can be purchased without waiting unless it is restricted.

Settlement service anchors

modules.html:
City settlement module · Swamp Marsh

City - Swamp Marsh

Broad, crowded, specialized, fashionable, and more expensive shopping, meals, housing, lodging, healing, crafting, transit, and repair services for a dark fantasy steampunk settlement.

Biome identity

stilt markets, poleboat rentals, peat fires, reed houses, leech doctors, mosquito-net inns, and marsh guide camps.

Market structure

district markets, guild halls, hotels, armory rows, hospitals, restaurants, bazaars, and licensed arcane counters. Fine goods, rare goods, and commissioned masterwork services are common.

Availability rule

Cities have full permanent districts; almost every listed item can be purchased without waiting unless it is restricted.

Settlement service anchors
HostelsInnsTavernsRestaurantsHotelsGeneral StoresMarketplacesArmoriesBlacksmithsCraft ShopsStablesHospitalsApothecariesAlchemistsMagic Item ShopsJewelersFurniture HallsTextile and Clothing ShopsPet SellersCourier and Guild OfficesHousing OfficeSkyship StationPortal Network Building
Included shop/service sections
  1. Location Profile
  2. Strict Placement Rules
  3. Meals, Drinks, Tea, Restaurants, Taverns, Inns, Hotels, and Hostels
  4. Lodging, Baths, Laundry, and Guest Services
  5. Housing Purchase and Rental Office
  6. Bulk Food, Grocers, Granaries, and Marketplaces
  7. General Store, Travel Gear, Bags, Rope, Kits, and Survival Goods
  8. Hospitals, Clinics, Temple Clinics, Healing Kits, and Medical Services
  9. Apothecary, Herbalist, Alchemist, Elixirs, Potions, Poisons, and Cannabis Remedies
  10. Armories and Blacksmiths: Weapons, Armor, Thundercoil Gear, and Repairs
  11. Craft Shops, Furniture, Decor, Textiles, Clothing, Repairs, and Household Goods
  12. Stables, Mount Sales, Mount Boarding, Wagons, Freight, and Caravan Services
  13. Pets, Kennels, Animal Training, and Familiar Brokers
  14. Magic Item Shops, Relic Brokers, Scribes, Charms, and Arcane Services
  15. Jewelers, Gemcutters, Relic Appraisers, and Luxury Ornament Shops
  16. Everyday Services: Scribes, Couriers, Bathhouses, Guilds, Banks, Guides, and Mercenaries
  17. Swamp Marsh Biome-Specific Goods and Services
  18. DM Use Notes

modules.html:
Town settlement module · Canyon Valley

Town - Canyon Valley

Fair-priced, varied, reliable, and built for locals plus travelers shopping, meals, housing, lodging, healing, crafting, transit, and repair services for a dark fantasy steampunk settlement.

Biome identity

cliff roads, rope bridges, switchback caravan yards, river-bottom markets, echo inns, gorge rail trestles, wind shelters, pulley lifts, and canyon rescue posts.

Market structure

town market square, guild street, stable yard, tavern row, clinic, smithy, and craft halls. Luxury goods are available in small batches or by commission.

Availability rule

Towns have permanent shops for most goods, with rare and masterwork goods handled by guild commission.

Settlement service anchors
HostelsInnsTavernsRestaurantsHotelsGeneral StoresMarketplacesArmoriesBlacksmithsCraft ShopsStablesHospitalsApothecariesAlchemistsMagic Item ShopsJewelersFurniture HallsTextile and Clothing ShopsPet SellersCourier and Guild OfficesHousing Office
Included shop/service sections
  1. Location Profile
  2. Strict Placement Rules
  3. Meals, Drinks, Tea, Restaurants, Taverns, Inns, Hotels, and Hostels
  4. Lodging, Baths, Laundry, and Guest Services
  5. Housing Purchase and Rental Office
  6. Bulk Food, Grocers, Granaries, and Marketplaces
  7. General Store, Travel Gear, Bags, Rope, Kits, and Survival Goods
  8. Hospitals, Clinics, Temple Clinics, Healing Kits, and Medical Services
  9. Apothecary, Herbalist, Alchemist, Elixirs, Potions, Poisons, and Cannabis Remedies
  10. Armories and Blacksmiths: Weapons, Armor, Thundercoil Gear, and Repairs
  11. Craft Shops, Furniture, Decor, Textiles, Clothing, Repairs, and Household Goods
  12. Stables, Mount Sales, Mount Boarding, Wagons, Freight, and Caravan Services
  13. Pets, Kennels, Animal Training, and Familiar Brokers
  14. Magic Item Shops, Relic Brokers, Scribes, Charms, and Arcane Services
  15. Jewelers, Gemcutters, Relic Appraisers, and Luxury Ornament Shops
  16. Everyday Services: Scribes, Couriers, Bathhouses, Guilds, Banks, Guides, and Mercenaries
  17. Canyon Valley Biome-Specific Goods and Services
  18. DM Use Notes

modules.html:
Town settlement module · Deep Mountain

Town - Deep Mountain

Fair-priced, varied, reliable, and built for locals plus travelers shopping, meals, housing, lodging, healing, crafting, transit, and repair services for a dark fantasy steampunk settlement.

Biome identity

underground halls, mine-rail stations, fungal farms, forge markets, crystal elevators, warm vents, cavern hostels, and tunnel stables.

Market structure

town market square, guild street, stable yard, tavern row, clinic, smithy, and craft halls. Luxury goods are available in small batches or by commission.

Availability rule

Towns have permanent shops for most goods, with rare and masterwork goods handled by guild commission.

Settlement service anchors
HostelsInnsTavernsRestaurantsHotelsGeneral StoresMarketplacesArmoriesBlacksmithsCraft ShopsStablesHospitalsApothecariesAlchemistsMagic Item ShopsJewelersFurniture HallsTextile and Clothing ShopsPet SellersCourier and Guild OfficesHousing Office
Included shop/service sections
  1. Location Profile
  2. Strict Placement Rules
  3. Meals, Drinks, Tea, Restaurants, Taverns, Inns, Hotels, and Hostels
  4. Lodging, Baths, Laundry, and Guest Services
  5. Housing Purchase and Rental Office
  6. Bulk Food, Grocers, Granaries, and Marketplaces
  7. General Store, Travel Gear, Bags, Rope, Kits, and Survival Goods
  8. Hospitals, Clinics, Temple Clinics, Healing Kits, and Medical Services
  9. Apothecary, Herbalist, Alchemist, Elixirs, Potions, Poisons, and Cannabis Remedies
  10. Armories and Blacksmiths: Weapons, Armor, Thundercoil Gear, and Repairs
  11. Craft Shops, Furniture, Decor, Textiles, Clothing, Repairs, and Household Goods
  12. Stables, Mount Sales, Mount Boarding, Wagons, Freight, and Caravan Services
  13. Pets, Kennels, Animal Training, and Familiar Brokers
  14. Magic Item Shops, Relic Brokers, Scribes, Charms, and Arcane Services
  15. Jewelers, Gemcutters, Relic Appraisers, and Luxury Ornament Shops
  16. Everyday Services: Scribes, Couriers, Bathhouses, Guilds, Banks, Guides, and Mercenaries
  17. Deep Mountain Biome-Specific Goods and Services
  18. DM Use Notes

modules.html:
Town settlement module · Deep Sea

Town - Deep Sea

Fair-priced, varied, reliable, and built for locals plus travelers shopping, meals, housing, lodging, healing, crafting, transit, and repair services for a dark fantasy steampunk settlement.

Biome identity

pressure-sealed guest halls, waterlock entries, coral markets, kelp farms, shellcraft stalls, submersible docks, and air-safe rooms for non-gilled guests.

Market structure

town market square, guild street, stable yard, tavern row, clinic, smithy, and craft halls. Luxury goods are available in small batches or by commission.

Availability rule

Towns have permanent shops for most goods, with rare and masterwork goods handled by guild commission.

Settlement service anchors

  10. Armories and Blacksmiths: Weapons, Armor, Thundercoil Gear, and Repairs
  11. Craft Shops, Furniture, Decor, Textiles, Clothing, Repairs, and Household Goods
  12. Stables, Mount Sales, Mount Boarding, Wagons, Freight, and Caravan Services
  13. Pets, Kennels, Animal Training, and Familiar Brokers
  14. Magic Item Shops, Relic Brokers, Scribes, Charms, and Arcane Services
  15. Jewelers, Gemcutters, Relic Appraisers, and Luxury Ornament Shops
  16. Everyday Services: Scribes, Couriers, Bathhouses, Guilds, Banks, Guides, and Mercenaries

  18. DM Use Notes

modules.html:
Town settlement module · Desert Badlands

Town - Desert Badlands

Fair-priced, varied, reliable, and built for locals plus travelers shopping, meals, housing, lodging, healing, crafting, transit, and repair services for a dark fantasy steampunk settlement.

Biome identity

shade courts, cistern markets, caravanserai, sun cloth sellers, glassworkers, spice tents, wind-scoured inns, and guarded wells.

Market structure

town market square, guild street, stable yard, tavern row, clinic, smithy, and craft halls. Luxury goods are available in small batches or by commission.

Availability rule

Towns have permanent shops for most goods, with rare and masterwork goods handled by guild commission.

Settlement service anchors
HostelsInnsTavernsRestaurantsHotelsGeneral StoresMarketplacesArmoriesBlacksmithsCraft ShopsStablesHospitalsApothecariesAlchemistsMagic Item ShopsJewelersFurniture HallsTextile and Clothing ShopsPet SellersCourier and Guild OfficesHousing Office
Included shop/service sections
  1. Location Profile
  2. Strict Placement Rules
  3. Meals, Drinks, Tea, Restaurants, Taverns, Inns, Hotels, and Hostels
  4. Lodging, Baths, Laundry, and Guest Services
  5. Housing Purchase and Rental Office
  6. Bulk Food, Grocers, Granaries, and Marketplaces
  7. General Store, Travel Gear, Bags, Rope, Kits, and Survival Goods
  8. Hospitals, Clinics, Temple Clinics, Healing Kits, and Medical Services
  9. Apothecary, Herbalist, Alchemist, Elixirs, Potions, Poisons, and Cannabis Remedies
  10. Armories and Blacksmiths: Weapons, Armor, Thundercoil Gear, and Repairs
  11. Craft Shops, Furniture, Decor, Textiles, Clothing, Repairs, and Household Goods
  12. Stables, Mount Sales, Mount Boarding, Wagons, Freight, and Caravan Services
  13. Pets, Kennels, Animal Training, and Familiar Brokers
  14. Magic Item Shops, Relic Brokers, Scribes, Charms, and Arcane Services
  15. Jewelers, Gemcutters, Relic Appraisers, and Luxury Ornament Shops
  16. Everyday Services: Scribes, Couriers, Bathhouses, Guilds, Banks, Guides, and Mercenaries
  17. Desert Badlands Biome-Specific Goods and Services
  18. DM Use Notes

modules.html:
Town settlement module · Forest

Town - Forest

Fair-priced, varied, reliable, and built for locals plus travelers shopping, meals, housing, lodging, healing, crafting, transit, and repair services for a dark fantasy steampunk settlement.

Biome identity

timber halls, herbal markets, bowyers, woodland inns, mushroom cellars, hunting lodges, and canopy ropeways.

Market structure

town market square, guild street, stable yard, tavern row, clinic, smithy, and craft halls. Luxury goods are available in small batches or by commission.

Availability rule

Towns have permanent shops for most goods, with rare and masterwork goods handled by guild commission.

Settlement service anchors

modules.html:
Town settlement module · Grassland Plains

Town - Grassland Plains

Fair-priced, varied, reliable, and built for locals plus travelers shopping, meals, housing, lodging, healing, crafting, transit, and repair services for a dark fantasy steampunk settlement.

Biome identity

open markets, riding yards, caravan circles, ranch stores, grain halls, hunting camps, and wide-road taverns.

Market structure

town market square, guild street, stable yard, tavern row, clinic, smithy, and craft halls. Luxury goods are available in small batches or by commission.

Availability rule

Towns have permanent shops for most goods, with rare and masterwork goods handled by guild commission.

Settlement service anchors
HostelsInnsTavernsRestaurantsHotelsGeneral StoresMarketplacesArmoriesBlacksmithsCraft ShopsStablesHospitalsApothecariesAlchemistsMagic Item ShopsJewelersFurniture HallsTextile and Clothing ShopsPet SellersCourier and Guild OfficesHousing Office
Included shop/service sections
  1. Location Profile
  2. Strict Placement Rules
  3. Meals, Drinks, Tea, Restaurants, Taverns, Inns, Hotels, and Hostels
  4. Lodging, Baths, Laundry, and Guest Services
  5. Housing Purchase and Rental Office
  6. Bulk Food, Grocers, Granaries, and Marketplaces
  7. General Store, Travel Gear, Bags, Rope, Kits, and Survival Goods
  8. Hospitals, Clinics, Temple Clinics, Healing Kits, and Medical Services
  9. Apothecary, Herbalist, Alchemist, Elixirs, Potions, Poisons, and Cannabis Remedies
  10. Armories and Blacksmiths: Weapons, Armor, Thundercoil Gear, and Repairs
  11. Craft Shops, Furniture, Decor, Textiles, Clothing, Repairs, and Household Goods
  12. Stables, Mount Sales, Mount Boarding, Wagons, Freight, and Caravan Services
  13. Pets, Kennels, Animal Training, and Familiar Brokers
  14. Magic Item Shops, Relic Brokers, Scribes, Charms, and Arcane Services
  15. Jewelers, Gemcutters, Relic Appraisers, and Luxury Ornament Shops
  16. Everyday Services: Scribes, Couriers, Bathhouses, Guilds, Banks, Guides, and Mercenaries
  17. Grassland Plains Biome-Specific Goods and Services
  18. DM Use Notes

modules.html:
Town settlement module · Hill Plateau

Town - Hill Plateau

Fair-priced, varied, reliable, and built for locals plus travelers shopping, meals, housing, lodging, healing, crafting, transit, and repair services for a dark fantasy steampunk settlement.

Biome identity

terraced markets, goat stables, ridge inns, windmills, stonecutters, slope farms, and hilltop watch posts.

Market structure

town market square, guild street, stable yard, tavern row, clinic, smithy, and craft halls. Luxury goods are available in small batches or by commission.

Availability rule

Towns have permanent shops for most goods, with rare and masterwork goods handled by guild commission.

Settlement service anchors
HostelsInnsTavernsRestaurantsHotelsGeneral StoresMarketplacesArmoriesBlacksmithsCraft ShopsStablesHospitalsApothecariesAlchemistsMagic Item ShopsJewelersFurniture HallsTextile and Clothing ShopsPet SellersCourier and Guild OfficesHousing Office
Included shop/service sections
  1. Location Profile
  2. Strict Placement Rules
  3. Meals, Drinks, Tea, Restaurants, Taverns, Inns, Hotels, and Hostels
  4. Lodging, Baths, Laundry, and Guest Services
  5. Housing Purchase and Rental Office
  6. Bulk Food, Grocers, Granaries, and Marketplaces
  7. General Store, Travel Gear, Bags, Rope, Kits, and Survival Goods
  8. Hospitals, Clinics, Temple Clinics, Healing Kits, and Medical Services
  9. Apothecary, Herbalist, Alchemist, Elixirs, Potions, Poisons, and Cannabis Remedies
  10. Armories and Blacksmiths: Weapons, Armor, Thundercoil Gear, and Repairs
  11. Craft Shops, Furniture, Decor, Textiles, Clothing, Repairs, and Household Goods
  12. Stables, Mount Sales, Mount Boarding, Wagons, Freight, and Caravan Services
  13. Pets, Kennels, Animal Training, and Familiar Brokers
  14. Magic Item Shops, Relic Brokers, Scribes, Charms, and Arcane Services
  15. Jewelers, Gemcutters, Relic Appraisers, and Luxury Ornament Shops
  16. Everyday Services: Scribes, Couriers, Bathhouses, Guilds, Banks, Guides, and Mercenaries
  17. Hill Plateau Biome-Specific Goods and Services
  18. DM Use Notes

modules.html:
Town settlement module · Island

Town - Island

Fair-priced, varied, reliable, and built for locals plus travelers shopping, meals, housing, lodging, healing, crafting, transit, and repair services for a dark fantasy steampunk settlement.

Biome identity

harbor markets, sail lofts, fish halls, inn piers, brine cellars, reef pilots, and ferry yards.

Market structure

town market square, guild street, stable yard, tavern row, clinic, smithy, and craft halls. Luxury goods are available in small batches or by commission.

Availability rule

Towns have permanent shops for most goods, with rare and masterwork goods handled by guild commission.

Settlement service anchors
HostelsInnsTavernsRestaurantsHotelsGeneral StoresMarketplacesArmoriesBlacksmithsCraft ShopsStablesHospitalsApothecariesAlchemistsMagic Item ShopsJewelersFurniture HallsTextile and Clothing ShopsPet SellersCourier and Guild OfficesHousing Office
Included shop/service sections
  1. Location Profile
  2. Strict Placement Rules
  3. Meals, Drinks, Tea, Restaurants, Taverns, Inns, Hotels, and Hostels
  4. Lodging, Baths, Laundry, and Guest Services
  5. Housing Purchase and Rental Office
  6. Bulk Food, Grocers, Granaries, and Marketplaces
  7. General Store, Travel Gear, Bags, Rope, Kits, and Survival Goods
  8. Hospitals, Clinics, Temple Clinics, Healing Kits, and Medical Services
  9. Apothecary, Herbalist, Alchemist, Elixirs, Potions, Poisons, and Cannabis Remedies
  10. Armories and Blacksmiths: Weapons, Armor, Thundercoil Gear, and Repairs
  11. Craft Shops, Furniture, Decor, Textiles, Clothing, Repairs, and Household Goods
  12. Stables, Mount Sales, Mount Boarding, Wagons, Freight, and Caravan Services
  13. Pets, Kennels, Animal Training, and Familiar Brokers
  14. Magic Item Shops, Relic Brokers, Scribes, Charms, and Arcane Services
  15. Jewelers, Gemcutters, Relic Appraisers, and Luxury Ornament Shops
  16. Everyday Services: Scribes, Couriers, Bathhouses, Guilds, Banks, Guides, and Mercenaries
  17. Island Biome-Specific Goods and Services
  18. DM Use Notes

modules.html:
Town settlement module · Lake River

Town - Lake River

Fair-priced, varied, reliable, and built for locals plus travelers shopping, meals, housing, lodging, healing, crafting, transit, and repair services for a dark fantasy steampunk settlement.

Biome identity

river docks, canal markets, reedcraft shops, ferry inns, fish smokehouses, water mills, and boatwright yards.

Market structure

town market square, guild street, stable yard, tavern row, clinic, smithy, and craft halls. Luxury goods are available in small batches or by commission.

Availability rule

Towns have permanent shops for most goods, with rare and masterwork goods handled by guild commission.

Settlement service anchors
HostelsInnsTavernsRestaurantsHotelsGeneral StoresMarketplacesArmoriesBlacksmithsCraft ShopsStablesHospitalsApothecariesAlchemistsMagic Item ShopsJewelersFurniture HallsTextile and Clothing ShopsPet SellersCourier and Guild OfficesHousing Office
Included shop/service sections
  1. Location Profile
  2. Strict Placement Rules
  3. Meals, Drinks, Tea, Restaurants, Taverns, Inns, Hotels, and Hostels
  4. Lodging, Baths, Laundry, and Guest Services
  5. Housing Purchase and Rental Office
  6. Bulk Food, Grocers, Granaries, and Marketplaces
  7. General Store, Travel Gear, Bags, Rope, Kits, and Survival Goods
  8. Hospitals, Clinics, Temple Clinics, Healing Kits, and Medical Services
  9. Apothecary, Herbalist, Alchemist, Elixirs, Potions, Poisons, and Cannabis Remedies
  10. Armories and Blacksmiths: Weapons, Armor, Thundercoil Gear, and Repairs
  11. Craft Shops, Furniture, Decor, Textiles, Clothing, Repairs, and Household Goods
  12. Stables, Mount Sales, Mount Boarding, Wagons, Freight, and Caravan Services
  13. Pets, Kennels, Animal Training, and Familiar Brokers
  14. Magic Item Shops, Relic Brokers, Scribes, Charms, and Arcane Services
  15. Jewelers, Gemcutters, Relic Appraisers, and Luxury Ornament Shops
  16. Everyday Services: Scribes, Couriers, Bathhouses, Guilds, Banks, Guides, and Mercenaries
  17. Lake River Biome-Specific Goods and Services
  18. DM Use Notes

modules.html:
Town settlement module · Mountain

Town - Mountain

Fair-priced, varied, reliable, and built for locals plus travelers shopping, meals, housing, lodging, healing, crafting, transit, and repair services for a dark fantasy steampunk settlement.

Biome identity

high-pass hostels, goat paths, rope bridges, alpine herb stalls, quarry yards, snow shelters, and switchback roads.

Market structure

town market square, guild street, stable yard, tavern row, clinic, smithy, and craft halls. Luxury goods are available in small batches or by commission.

Availability rule

Towns have permanent shops for most goods, with rare and masterwork goods handled by guild commission.

Settlement service anchors

modules.html:
Town settlement module · Rainforest

Town - Rainforest

Fair-priced, varied, reliable, and built for locals plus travelers shopping, meals, housing, lodging, healing, crafting, transit, and repair services for a dark fantasy steampunk settlement.

Biome identity

canopy markets, covered walkways, medicinal gardens, insect-screen hostels, river skiffs, resin craft shops, and storm shelters.

Market structure

town market square, guild street, stable yard, tavern row, clinic, smithy, and craft halls. Luxury goods are available in small batches or by commission.

Availability rule

Towns have permanent shops for most goods, with rare and masterwork goods handled by guild commission.

Settlement service anchors
HostelsInnsTavernsRestaurantsHotelsGeneral StoresMarketplacesArmoriesBlacksmithsCraft ShopsStablesHospitalsApothecariesAlchemistsMagic Item ShopsJewelersFurniture HallsTextile and Clothing ShopsPet SellersCourier and Guild OfficesHousing Office
Included shop/service sections
  1. Location Profile
  2. Strict Placement Rules
  3. Meals, Drinks, Tea, Restaurants, Taverns, Inns, Hotels, and Hostels
  4. Lodging, Baths, Laundry, and Guest Services
  5. Housing Purchase and Rental Office
  6. Bulk Food, Grocers, Granaries, and Marketplaces
  7. General Store, Travel Gear, Bags, Rope, Kits, and Survival Goods
  8. Hospitals, Clinics, Temple Clinics, Healing Kits, and Medical Services
  9. Apothecary, Herbalist, Alchemist, Elixirs, Potions, Poisons, and Cannabis Remedies
  10. Armories and Blacksmiths: Weapons, Armor, Thundercoil Gear, and Repairs
  11. Craft Shops, Furniture, Decor, Textiles, Clothing, Repairs, and Household Goods
  12. Stables, Mount Sales, Mount Boarding, Wagons, Freight, and Caravan Services
  13. Pets, Kennels, Animal Training, and Familiar Brokers
  14. Magic Item Shops, Relic Brokers, Scribes, Charms, and Arcane Services
  15. Jewelers, Gemcutters, Relic Appraisers, and Luxury Ornament Shops
  16. Everyday Services: Scribes, Couriers, Bathhouses, Guilds, Banks, Guides, and Mercenaries
  17. Rainforest Biome-Specific Goods and Services
  18. DM Use Notes

modules.html:
Town settlement module · Surface Docks Coastal

Town - Surface Docks Coastal

Fair-priced, varied, reliable, and built for locals plus travelers shopping, meals, housing, lodging, healing, crafting, transit, and repair services for a dark fantasy steampunk settlement.

Biome identity

steamship docks, warehouses, seafood markets, ship chandlers, dock taverns, ferry offices, and coastal patrol posts.

Market structure

town market square, guild street, stable yard, tavern row, clinic, smithy, and craft halls. Luxury goods are available in small batches or by commission.

Availability rule

Towns have permanent shops for most goods, with rare and masterwork goods handled by guild commission.

Settlement service anchors
HostelsInnsTavernsRestaurantsHotelsGeneral StoresMarketplacesArmoriesBlacksmithsCraft ShopsStablesHospitalsApothecariesAlchemistsMagic Item ShopsJewelersFurniture HallsTextile and Clothing ShopsPet SellersCourier and Guild OfficesHousing Office
Included shop/service sections

  2. Strict Placement Rules
  3. Meals, Drinks, Tea, Restaurants, Taverns, Inns, Hotels, and Hostels
  4. Lodging, Baths, Laundry, and Guest Services

  7. General Store, Travel Gear, Bags, Rope, Kits, and Survival Goods

  9. Apothecary, Herbalist, Alchemist, Elixirs, Potions, Poisons, and Cannabis Remedies
  10. Armories and Blacksmiths: Weapons, Armor, Thundercoil Gear, and Repairs
  11. Craft Shops, Furniture, Decor, Textiles, Clothing, Repairs, and Household Goods
  12. Stables, Mount Sales, Mount Boarding, Wagons, Freight, and Caravan Services
  13. Pets, Kennels, Animal Training, and Familiar Brokers

  15. Jewelers, Gemcutters, Relic Appraisers, and Luxury Ornament Shops
  16. Everyday Services: Scribes, Couriers, Bathhouses, Guilds, Banks, Guides, and Mercenaries

  18. DM Use Notes

Weapons, armor, ammunition, shields, and thundercoil gear are sold through armories, with repair and forged basics also handled by blacksmiths. modules.html:
Town settlement module · Swamp Marsh

Town - Swamp Marsh

Fair-priced, varied, reliable, and built for locals plus travelers shopping, meals, housing, lodging, healing, crafting, transit, and repair services for a dark fantasy steampunk settlement.

Biome identity

stilt markets, poleboat rentals, peat fires, reed houses, leech doctors, mosquito-net inns, and marsh guide camps.

Market structure

town market square, guild street, stable yard, tavern row, clinic, smithy, and craft halls. Luxury goods are available in small batches or by commission.

Availability rule

Towns have permanent shops for most goods, with rare and masterwork goods handled by guild commission.

Settlement service anchors
HostelsInnsTavernsRestaurantsHotelsGeneral StoresMarketplacesArmoriesBlacksmithsCraft ShopsStablesHospitalsApothecariesAlchemistsMagic Item ShopsJewelersFurniture HallsTextile and Clothing ShopsPet SellersCourier and Guild OfficesHousing Office
Included shop/service sections
  1. Location Profile
  2. Strict Placement Rules
  3. Meals, Drinks, Tea, Restaurants, Taverns, Inns, Hotels, and Hostels
  4. Lodging, Baths, Laundry, and Guest Services
  5. Housing Purchase and Rental Office
  6. Bulk Food, Grocers, Granaries, and Marketplaces
  7. General Store, Travel Gear, Bags, Rope, Kits, and Survival Goods
  8. Hospitals, Clinics, Temple Clinics, Healing Kits, and Medical Services
  9. Apothecary, Herbalist, Alchemist, Elixirs, Potions, Poisons, and Cannabis Remedies
  10. Armories and Blacksmiths: Weapons, Armor, Thundercoil Gear, and Repairs
  11. Craft Shops, Furniture, Decor, Textiles, Clothing, Repairs, and Household Goods
  12. Stables, Mount Sales, Mount Boarding, Wagons, Freight, and Caravan Services
  13. Pets, Kennels, Animal Training, and Familiar Brokers
  14. Magic Item Shops, Relic Brokers, Scribes, Charms, and Arcane Services
  15. Jewelers, Gemcutters, Relic Appraisers, and Luxury Ornament Shops
  16. Everyday Services: Scribes, Couriers, Bathhouses, Guilds, Banks, Guides, and Mercenaries
  17. Swamp Marsh Biome-Specific Goods and Services
  18. DM Use Notes

modules.html:
Village settlement module · Canyon Valley

Village - Canyon Valley

Cheap, practical, hearty, local, and generous shopping, meals, housing, lodging, healing, crafting, transit, and repair services for a dark fantasy steampunk settlement.

Biome identity

cliff roads, rope bridges, switchback caravan yards, river-bottom markets, echo inns, gorge rail trestles, wind shelters, pulley lifts, and canyon rescue posts.

Market structure

small common market, hearth inn, livery yard, herb counter, smith stall, and traveling peddlers. Rare luxury goods require ordering through a caravan factor.

Availability rule

Villages list the same categories so the DM has a designated place for every purchase, but rare items are special orders, traveling-stall stock, shrine stock, or one-at-a-time commissions.

Settlement service anchors
HostelsInnsTavernsRestaurantsHotelsGeneral StoresMarketplacesArmoriesBlacksmithsCraft ShopsStablesHospitalsApothecariesAlchemistsMagic Item ShopsJewelersFurniture HallsTextile and Clothing ShopsPet SellersCourier and Guild OfficesHousing Office
Included shop/service sections
  1. Location Profile
  2. Strict Placement Rules
  3. Meals, Drinks, Tea, Restaurants, Taverns, Inns, Hotels, and Hostels
  4. Lodging, Baths, Laundry, and Guest Services
  5. Housing Purchase and Rental Office
  6. Bulk Food, Grocers, Granaries, and Marketplaces
  7. General Store, Travel Gear, Bags, Rope, Kits, and Survival Goods
  8. Hospitals, Clinics, Temple Clinics, Healing Kits, and Medical Services
  9. Apothecary, Herbalist, Alchemist, Elixirs, Potions, Poisons, and Cannabis Remedies
  10. Armories and Blacksmiths: Weapons, Armor, Thundercoil Gear, and Repairs
  11. Craft Shops, Furniture, Decor, Textiles, Clothing, Repairs, and Household Goods
  12. Stables, Mount Sales, Mount Boarding, Wagons, Freight, and Caravan Services
  13. Pets, Kennels, Animal Training, and Familiar Brokers
  14. Magic Item Shops, Relic Brokers, Scribes, Charms, and Arcane Services
  15. Jewelers, Gemcutters, Relic Appraisers, and Luxury Ornament Shops
  16. Everyday Services: Scribes, Couriers, Bathhouses, Guilds, Banks, Guides, and Mercenaries
  17. Canyon Valley Biome-Specific Goods and Services
  18. DM Use Notes

modules.html:
Village settlement module · Deep Mountain

Village - Deep Mountain

Cheap, practical, hearty, local, and generous shopping, meals, housing, lodging, healing, crafting, transit, and repair services for a dark fantasy steampunk settlement.

Biome identity

underground halls, mine-rail stations, fungal farms, forge markets, crystal elevators, warm vents, cavern hostels, and tunnel stables.

Market structure

small common market, hearth inn, livery yard, herb counter, smith stall, and traveling peddlers. Rare luxury goods require ordering through a caravan factor.

Availability rule

Villages list the same categories so the DM has a designated place for every purchase, but rare items are special orders, traveling-stall stock, shrine stock, or one-at-a-time commissions.

Settlement service anchors
HostelsInnsTavernsRestaurantsHotelsGeneral StoresMarketplacesArmoriesBlacksmithsCraft ShopsStablesHospitalsApothecariesAlchemistsMagic Item ShopsJewelersFurniture HallsTextile and Clothing ShopsPet SellersCourier and Guild OfficesHousing Office
Included shop/service sections
  1. Location Profile
  2. Strict Placement Rules
  3. Meals, Drinks, Tea, Restaurants, Taverns, Inns, Hotels, and Hostels
  4. Lodging, Baths, Laundry, and Guest Services
  5. Housing Purchase and Rental Office
  6. Bulk Food, Grocers, Granaries, and Marketplaces
  7. General Store, Travel Gear, Bags, Rope, Kits, and Survival Goods
  8. Hospitals, Clinics, Temple Clinics, Healing Kits, and Medical Services
  9. Apothecary, Herbalist, Alchemist, Elixirs, Potions, Poisons, and Cannabis Remedies
  10. Armories and Blacksmiths: Weapons, Armor, Thundercoil Gear, and Repairs
  11. Craft Shops, Furniture, Decor, Textiles, Clothing, Repairs, and Household Goods
  12. Stables, Mount Sales, Mount Boarding, Wagons, Freight, and Caravan Services
  13. Pets, Kennels, Animal Training, and Familiar Brokers
  14. Magic Item Shops, Relic Brokers, Scribes, Charms, and Arcane Services
  15. Jewelers, Gemcutters, Relic Appraisers, and Luxury Ornament Shops
  16. Everyday Services: Scribes, Couriers, Bathhouses, Guilds, Banks, Guides, and Mercenaries
  17. Deep Mountain Biome-Specific Goods and Services
  18. DM Use Notes

modules.html:
Village settlement module · Deep Sea

Village - Deep Sea

Cheap, practical, hearty, local, and generous shopping, meals, housing, lodging, healing, crafting, transit, and repair services for a dark fantasy steampunk settlement.

Biome identity

pressure-sealed guest halls, waterlock entries, coral markets, kelp farms, shellcraft stalls, submersible docks, and air-safe rooms for non-gilled guests.

Market structure

small common market, hearth inn, livery yard, herb counter, smith stall, and traveling peddlers. Rare luxury goods require ordering through a caravan factor.

Availability rule

Villages list the same categories so the DM has a designated place for every purchase, but rare items are special orders, traveling-stall stock, shrine stock, or one-at-a-time commissions.

Settlement service anchors
HostelsInnsTavernsRestaurantsHotelsGeneral StoresMarketplacesArmoriesBlacksmithsCraft ShopsStablesHospitalsApothecariesAlchemistsMagic Item ShopsJewelersFurniture HallsTextile and Clothing ShopsPet SellersCourier and Guild OfficesHousing Office
Included shop/service sections
  1. Location Profile
  2. Strict Placement Rules
  3. Meals, Drinks, Tea, Restaurants, Taverns, Inns, Hotels, and Hostels
  4. Lodging, Baths, Laundry, and Guest Services
  5. Housing Purchase and Rental Office
  6. Bulk Food, Grocers, Granaries, and Marketplaces
  7. General Store, Travel Gear, Bags, Rope, Kits, and Survival Goods
  8. Hospitals, Clinics, Temple Clinics, Healing Kits, and Medical Services
  9. Apothecary, Herbalist, Alchemist, Elixirs, Potions, Poisons, and Cannabis Remedies
  10. Armories and Blacksmiths: Weapons, Armor, Thundercoil Gear, and Repairs
  11. Craft Shops, Furniture, Decor, Textiles, Clothing, Repairs, and Household Goods
  12. Stables, Mount Sales, Mount Boarding, Wagons, Freight, and Caravan Services
  13. Pets, Kennels, Animal Training, and Familiar Brokers
  14. Magic Item Shops, Relic Brokers, Scribes, Charms, and Arcane Services
  15. Jewelers, Gemcutters, Relic Appraisers, and Luxury Ornament Shops
  16. Everyday Services: Scribes, Couriers, Bathhouses, Guilds, Banks, Guides, and Mercenaries
  17. Deep Sea Biome-Specific Goods and Services
  18. DM Use Notes

modules.html:
Village settlement module · Desert Badlands

Village - Desert Badlands

Cheap, practical, hearty, local, and generous shopping, meals, housing, lodging, healing, crafting, transit, and repair services for a dark fantasy steampunk settlement.

Biome identity

shade courts, cistern markets, caravanserai, sun cloth sellers, glassworkers, spice tents, wind-scoured inns, and guarded wells.

Market structure

small common market, hearth inn, livery yard, herb counter, smith stall, and traveling peddlers. Rare luxury goods require ordering through a caravan factor.

Availability rule

Villages list the same categories so the DM has a designated place for every purchase, but rare items are special orders, traveling-stall stock, shrine stock, or one-at-a-time commissions.

Settlement service anchors
HostelsInnsTavernsRestaurantsHotelsGeneral StoresMarketplacesArmoriesBlacksmithsCraft ShopsStablesHospitalsApothecariesAlchemistsMagic Item ShopsJewelersFurniture HallsTextile and Clothing ShopsPet SellersCourier and Guild OfficesHousing Office
Included shop/service sections
  1. Location Profile
  2. Strict Placement Rules
  3. Meals, Drinks, Tea, Restaurants, Taverns, Inns, Hotels, and Hostels
  4. Lodging, Baths, Laundry, and Guest Services
  5. Housing Purchase and Rental Office
  6. Bulk Food, Grocers, Granaries, and Marketplaces
  7. General Store, Travel Gear, Bags, Rope, Kits, and Survival Goods
  8. Hospitals, Clinics, Temple Clinics, Healing Kits, and Medical Services
  9. Apothecary, Herbalist, Alchemist, Elixirs, Potions, Poisons, and Cannabis Remedies
  10. Armories and Blacksmiths: Weapons, Armor, Thundercoil Gear, and Repairs
  11. Craft Shops, Furniture, Decor, Textiles, Clothing, Repairs, and Household Goods
  12. Stables, Mount Sales, Mount Boarding, Wagons, Freight, and Caravan Services
  13. Pets, Kennels, Animal Training, and Familiar Brokers
  14. Magic Item Shops, Relic Brokers, Scribes, Charms, and Arcane Services
  15. Jewelers, Gemcutters, Relic Appraisers, and Luxury Ornament Shops
  16. Everyday Services: Scribes, Couriers, Bathhouses, Guilds, Banks, Guides, and Mercenaries
  17. Desert Badlands Biome-Specific Goods and Services
  18. DM Use Notes

modules.html:
Village settlement module · Forest

Village - Forest

Cheap, practical, hearty, local, and generous shopping, meals, housing, lodging, healing, crafting, transit, and repair services for a dark fantasy steampunk settlement.

Biome identity

timber halls, herbal markets, bowyers, woodland inns, mushroom cellars, hunting lodges, and canopy ropeways.

Market structure

small common market, hearth inn, livery yard, herb counter, smith stall, and traveling peddlers. Rare luxury goods require ordering through a caravan factor.

Availability rule

Villages list the same categories so the DM has a designated place for every purchase, but rare items are special orders, traveling-stall stock, shrine stock, or one-at-a-time commissions.

Settlement service anchors
HostelsInnsTavernsRestaurantsHotelsGeneral StoresMarketplacesArmoriesBlacksmithsCraft ShopsStablesHospitalsApothecariesAlchemistsMagic Item ShopsJewelersFurniture HallsTextile and Clothing ShopsPet SellersCourier and Guild OfficesHousing Office
Included shop/service sections
  1. Location Profile
  2. Strict Placement Rules
  3. Meals, Drinks, Tea, Restaurants, Taverns, Inns, Hotels, and Hostels
  4. Lodging, Baths, Laundry, and Guest Services
  5. Housing Purchase and Rental Office
  6. Bulk Food, Grocers, Granaries, and Marketplaces
  7. General Store, Travel Gear, Bags, Rope, Kits, and Survival Goods
  8. Hospitals, Clinics, Temple Clinics, Healing Kits, and Medical Services
  9. Apothecary, Herbalist, Alchemist, Elixirs, Potions, Poisons, and Cannabis Remedies
  10. Armories and Blacksmiths: Weapons, Armor, Thundercoil Gear, and Repairs
  11. Craft Shops, Furniture, Decor, Textiles, Clothing, Repairs, and Household Goods
  12. Stables, Mount Sales, Mount Boarding, Wagons, Freight, and Caravan Services
  13. Pets, Kennels, Animal Training, and Familiar Brokers
  14. Magic Item Shops, Relic Brokers, Scribes, Charms, and Arcane Services
  15. Jewelers, Gemcutters, Relic Appraisers, and Luxury Ornament Shops
  16. Everyday Services: Scribes, Couriers, Bathhouses, Guilds, Banks, Guides, and Mercenaries
  17. Forest Biome-Specific Goods and Services
  18. DM Use Notes

modules.html:
Village settlement module · Grassland Plains

Village - Grassland Plains

Cheap, practical, hearty, local, and generous shopping, meals, housing, lodging, healing, crafting, transit, and repair services for a dark fantasy steampunk settlement.

Biome identity

open markets, riding yards, caravan circles, ranch stores, grain halls, hunting camps, and wide-road taverns.

Market structure

small common market, hearth inn, livery yard, herb counter, smith stall, and traveling peddlers. Rare luxury goods require ordering through a caravan factor.

Availability rule

Villages list the same categories so the DM has a designated place for every purchase, but rare items are special orders, traveling-stall stock, shrine stock, or one-at-a-time commissions.

Settlement service anchors
HostelsInnsTavernsRestaurantsHotelsGeneral StoresMarketplacesArmoriesBlacksmithsCraft ShopsStablesHospitalsApothecariesAlchemistsMagic Item ShopsJewelersFurniture HallsTextile and Clothing ShopsPet SellersCourier and Guild OfficesHousing Office
Included shop/service sections
  1. Location Profile
  2. Strict Placement Rules
  3. Meals, Drinks, Tea, Restaurants, Taverns, Inns, Hotels, and Hostels
  4. Lodging, Baths, Laundry, and Guest Services
  5. Housing Purchase and Rental Office
  6. Bulk Food, Grocers, Granaries, and Marketplaces
  7. General Store, Travel Gear, Bags, Rope, Kits, and Survival Goods
  8. Hospitals, Clinics, Temple Clinics, Healing Kits, and Medical Services
  9. Apothecary, Herbalist, Alchemist, Elixirs, Potions, Poisons, and Cannabis Remedies
  10. Armories and Blacksmiths: Weapons, Armor, Thundercoil Gear, and Repairs
  11. Craft Shops, Furniture, Decor, Textiles, Clothing, Repairs, and Household Goods
  12. Stables, Mount Sales, Mount Boarding, Wagons, Freight, and Caravan Services
  13. Pets, Kennels, Animal Training, and Familiar Brokers
  14. Magic Item Shops, Relic Brokers, Scribes, Charms, and Arcane Services
  15. Jewelers, Gemcutters, Relic Appraisers, and Luxury Ornament Shops
  16. Everyday Services: Scribes, Couriers, Bathhouses, Guilds, Banks, Guides, and Mercenaries
  17. Grassland Plains Biome-Specific Goods and Services
  18. DM Use Notes

modules.html:
Village settlement module · Hill Plateau

Village - Hill Plateau

Cheap, practical, hearty, local, and generous shopping, meals, housing, lodging, healing, crafting, transit, and repair services for a dark fantasy steampunk settlement.

Biome identity

terraced markets, goat stables, ridge inns, windmills, stonecutters, slope farms, and hilltop watch posts.

Market structure

small common market, hearth inn, livery yard, herb counter, smith stall, and traveling peddlers. Rare luxury goods require ordering through a caravan factor.

Availability rule

Villages list the same categories so the DM has a designated place for every purchase, but rare items are special orders, traveling-stall stock, shrine stock, or one-at-a-time commissions.

Settlement service anchors

modules.html:
Village settlement module · Island

Village - Island

Cheap, practical, hearty, local, and generous shopping, meals, housing, lodging, healing, crafting, transit, and repair services for a dark fantasy steampunk settlement.

Biome identity

harbor markets, sail lofts, fish halls, inn piers, brine cellars, reef pilots, and ferry yards.

Market structure

small common market, hearth inn, livery yard, herb counter, smith stall, and traveling peddlers. Rare luxury goods require ordering through a caravan factor.

Availability rule

Villages list the same categories so the DM has a designated place for every purchase, but rare items are special orders, traveling-stall stock, shrine stock, or one-at-a-time commissions.

Settlement service anchors
HostelsInnsTavernsRestaurantsHotelsGeneral StoresMarketplacesArmoriesBlacksmithsCraft ShopsStablesHospitalsApothecariesAlchemistsMagic Item ShopsJewelersFurniture HallsTextile and Clothing ShopsPet SellersCourier and Guild OfficesHousing Office
Included shop/service sections
  1. Location Profile
  2. Strict Placement Rules
  3. Meals, Drinks, Tea, Restaurants, Taverns, Inns, Hotels, and Hostels
  4. Lodging, Baths, Laundry, and Guest Services
  5. Housing Purchase and Rental Office
  6. Bulk Food, Grocers, Granaries, and Marketplaces
  7. General Store, Travel Gear, Bags, Rope, Kits, and Survival Goods
  8. Hospitals, Clinics, Temple Clinics, Healing Kits, and Medical Services
  9. Apothecary, Herbalist, Alchemist, Elixirs, Potions, Poisons, and Cannabis Remedies
  10. Armories and Blacksmiths: Weapons, Armor, Thundercoil Gear, and Repairs
  11. Craft Shops, Furniture, Decor, Textiles, Clothing, Repairs, and Household Goods
  12. Stables, Mount Sales, Mount Boarding, Wagons, Freight, and Caravan Services
  13. Pets, Kennels, Animal Training, and Familiar Brokers
  14. Magic Item Shops, Relic Brokers, Scribes, Charms, and Arcane Services
  15. Jewelers, Gemcutters, Relic Appraisers, and Luxury Ornament Shops
  16. Everyday Services: Scribes, Couriers, Bathhouses, Guilds, Banks, Guides, and Mercenaries
  17. Island Biome-Specific Goods and Services
  18. DM Use Notes
